summary: Two batch operations applied to each selected object individually, not to the selection as a group.
overview: Add a child to each selected object, or wrap each in its own empty parent. The word EACH is the point: Unity's own Group Selected bundles everything under one shared new parent, which is deliberately not what this does.
useCases: Giving fifty props an empty pivot parent each, for rotation offsets.
Adding a marker or collider child to every selected object at once.
Restructuring a hierarchy without doing it fifty times by hand.

gotchas.title: Each, not the group
gotchas.body: Twenty selected objects gives twenty new parents, not one. If you wanted one, Unity's Ctrl+Alt+G already does that.
